name: Cleansing Hands, Greater
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level adept 5, alchemist 5, cleric/oracle 5, druid 6, inquisitor 5, paladin 4, shaman 6, white necromancer 5, witch .

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as cleansing hands except it heals 4d8 + your caster level (maximum +20) and in addition to the previous lists of conditions, you can remove the feebleminded and insanity conditions. Instead of removing one of the conditions, remove all ability damage to all ability scores.
